question_text: Mr. Dela Cruz is a city planning officer whose wife owns a construction company. The city is about to bid out a road project. Under Section 3 of RA 6713, which of the following situations would constitute a conflict of interest?

options.text: Mr. Dela Cruz abstains from participating in the bidding process entirely.
Mr. Dela Cruz's wife's company submits a bid, and Mr. Dela Cruz is part of the bidding committee.
Mr. Dela Cruz's wife's company does not submit a bid, but Mr. Dela Cruz helps evaluate other bids.
Mr. Dela Cruz discloses his wife's business interest to his supervisor and is reassigned to a different department.
